info.title: KingdomOps local API
info.summary: Local-only backend for kingdom spaces and farm/MGE/council sync.
info.description:
Local-only backend (`apps/api`, node:http + node:sqlite) for kingdom spaces and sync of farms, MGE and council documents. It is not deployed anywhere.

General behaviour:
- Every body is `application/json` (otherwise 415) and at most 540672 bytes (otherwise 413).
- Authenticated routes take `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Missing or unknown token: 401. Token of another space, a space that does not exist, or a role that is not enough: 403.
- `x-rokadm-auth` on each operation is the required role: `none`, `member` or `admin`.
- Rate limits apply everywhere (429); creating a space and joining use a stricter bucket.
- An unknown route answers 404 `not_found`; a known path with a wrong method answers 405.
- Unexpected failures answer 500 `internal` with a generic message.
- Errors use ErrorResponse `{ error, message, issues? }`.

license.name: Local-only; not deployed and not licensed for public hosting

tags.name: spaces
tags.description: Create, join, read and delete spaces.

tags.name: docs
tags.description: Synced documents: farms, MGE plan, council requirements, kingdom.

post.description: Creates a space, its first admin member and a first invite. The token and invite code are shown only in this response. Stricter rate limit.

post.summary: Join a space with an invite code

201.description: Joined; the token is shown only here.

get.summary: The space and the calling member

delete.description: Erases all data of the space: members, tokens, invites, documents and audit log.

204.description: Space and all its data erased.

delete.summary: Remove a member or leave the space
delete.description: `me` leaves the space. An admin may remove others; a member removing someone else gets 403. The last admin cannot leave while other members remain (409 limit_reached).

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: A member id, or `me` for the caller.

204.description: Member removed and their tokens revoked.

get.description: Codes are never returned here; only their metadata.

post.description: The body is optional; defaults apply. The code is shown only in this response.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only documents of this kind; an unknown kind is a 400.

put.description: Optimistic concurrency: `baseVersion` 0 creates, otherwise it must equal the stored version. Members may not write admin-only kinds (mge-plan, council-requirements, kingdom) and may only write `farms` documents they own (403). 409 is either a ConflictResponse (`version_conflict`, `current` may be null) or an ErrorResponse `limit_reached` (too many documents in the space).

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version the client last saw.

get.description: Newest first. `before` pages backwards by entry id.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only entries with an id lower than this.

bearerAuth.description: Token returned once by createSpace or join.

InviteCode.description: Shown once. 12 symbols from 23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ, usually formatted XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

InviteWithCode.description: InviteInfo plus the plain code, returned only when the invite is created.

FarmLevels.description: Missing fields are stored as null.

name.description: Trimmed; 1..40 characters after trimming; control characters and U+2028/U+2029 are rejected.

note.description: Trimmed; 0..200 characters after trimming; control characters and U+2028/U+2029 are rejected.

farmId.description: Must be the id of a farm in the same document.

note.description: Trimmed; 0..200 characters after trimming; control characters and U+2028/U+2029 are rejected.

FarmsDocData.description: `data` of a `farms` document (one ko:farms:v1 store). Farm ids and shipment ids are unique.

GenericDocData.description: `data` of the generic kinds: any JSON object, at most 8 levels deep, strings up to 4000 characters, finite numbers, keys up to 128 characters and never __proto__, constructor or prototype. Serialized size up to 524288 bytes.

DocData.description: FarmsDocData when kind is `farms`; GenericDocData otherwise.

current.description: The server's current document, or null when it no longer exists.

name.description: Trimmed; 1..60 characters after trimming; control characters and U+2028/U+2029 are rejected.

displayName.description: Trimmed; 1..32 characters after trimming; control characters and U+2028/U+2029 are rejected.

token.description: Bearer token, shown once; the server keeps only an HMAC of it.

inviteCode.description: Case-insensitive; spaces and dashes are ignored. Must normalize to 12 symbols of 23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ.

displayName.description: Trimmed; 1..32 characters after trimming; control characters and U+2028/U+2029 are rejected.

baseVersion.description: 0 to create; otherwise the version the client last saw.

BadRequest.description: `bad_request` or `validation_failed`: malformed JSON, invalid parameter or a body that fails validation (`issues` lists each problem).

Unauthorized.description: `unauthorized`: missing, malformed or unknown bearer token.

Forbidden.description: `forbidden`: the token belongs to another space, the space does not exist, or the member's role is not enough.

InviteInvalid.description: `invite_invalid`: the invite is unknown, expired, revoked or used up. The message is the same in every case.

PayloadTooLarge.description: `payload_too_large`: the request body exceeds 540672 bytes or the document data exceeds 524288 bytes.

VersionConflict.description: `version_conflict`: `baseVersion`/`version` does not match the stored document.
